rules.name: Flak
rules.text: All enemy with the Flak special rule automatically fire at the attacking aircraft if the token model lies within their range and firing arc, regardless of whether they have already taken an action or not that turn. Flak fire does not require an action and takes place outside of the normal turn sequence. Firing a pintle-mounted machine gun flak weapon against an attacking aircraft does not make the vehicle count as open-topped for the turn. Any flak units in Ambush retain their Ambush status if they shoot at an aircraft. Hidden lose their hidden status. Friendly units must test to hold their fire (Inexperienced 4+, Regular 3+, Veteran 2+) - in case of Rookie pilot all flak units open fire automatically. Measure range - Line of Site ignored. Flak weapons not pinned hit on 5+, pinner hit on 6 - ignore all other modifiers. If HE hits, multiply as for inside a building. If 3 or more hits, shot down.

rules.name: HE (1")

rules.name: Open-topped
rules.text: Pinned by hits from small arms in the same way as soft-skins and infantry. If assaulted by infantry, open-topped armoured vehicles are destroyed automatically if the vehicle is damaged, in the same way as for soft-skins. If hit against top armour then add an additional +1 to the damage result roll. Note that all hits upon the upper surface of armoured vehicles count +1 penetration regardless of whether the target is open or not - so open-topped armoured vehicles suffer a double penalty: +1 penetration and +1 damage result

rules.name: Flamethrower
rules.text: Hits from flamethowers allow no cover saves. When shooting with a flamethrower, roll a single die to hit as normal, but if you score a hit, it is turned into D6 hits (or D6+1 in the case of a vehicle-mounted flamethrower). As no saves are allowed, simply roll for damaage in the usual manner. Flamethrowers always hit the top armour of vehicles. Also, they don't suffer the -1 Pen penalty when firing at long range against armoured vehicles, nor the +1 Pen for firing at point-blank range. Causes D3+1 pins to target, 1 pin to firing unit. A unit hit by a flamethrower must check its morale regardless of casualties. After shooting roll a D6 (for each flamethrower fired). On a result of 1 or 2 the flamethrower has run out of fuel. Infantry: replace model with unarmed model, else remove the model instead (no morale check caused). Vehicles: no other effects. When rolling on Vehicle Damage Results table against a vehicle equipped with flamethrowers, add an extra +1 to the roll.

rules.name: Internal volatile fuel tanks

rules.name: Flak
rules.text: All enemy with the Flak special rule automatically fire at the attacking aircraft if the token model lies within their range and firing arc, regardless of whether they have already taken an action or not that turn. Flak fire does not require an action and takes place outside of the normal turn sequence. Firing a pintle-mounted machine gun flak weapon against an attacking aircraft does not make the vehicle count as open-topped for the turn. Any flak units in Ambush retain their Ambush status if they shoot at an aircraft. Hidden lose their hidden status. Friendly units must test to hold their fire (Inexperienced 4+, Regular 3+, Veteran 2+) - in case of Rookie pilot all flak units open fire automatically. Measure range - Line of Site ignored. rules.name: Flamethrower
rules.text: Hits from flamethowers allow no cover saves. When shooting with a flamethrower, roll a single die to hit as normal, but if you score a hit, it is turned into D6 hits (or D6+1 in the case of a vehicle-mounted flamethrower). As no saves are allowed, simply roll for damaage in the usual manner. Flamethrowers always hit the top armour of vehicles. Also, they don't suffer the -1 Pen penalty when firing at long range against armoured vehicles, nor the +1 Pen for firing at point-blank range. Causes D3+1 pins to target, 1 pin to firing unit. A unit hit by a flamethrower must check its morale regardless of casualties. After shooting roll a D6 (for each flamethrower fired). On a result of 1 or 2 the flamethrower has run out of fuel. Infantry: replace model with unarmed model, else remove the model instead (no morale check caused). Vehicles: no other effects. When rolling on Vehicle Damage Results table against a vehicle equipped with flamethrowers, add an extra +1 to the roll.

Also, they don't suffer the -1 Pen penalty when firing at long range against armoured vehicles, nor the +1 Pen for firing at point-blank range. Causes D3+1 pins to target, 1 pin to firing unit. A unit hit by a flamethrower must check its morale regardless of casualties. After shooting roll a D6 (for each flamethrower fired). On a result of 1 or 2 the flamethrower has run out of fuel. rules.name: Heavy Charge
rules.text: The heavy charge can only be used once per game, but it does indeed go off with a huge bang. In order to use the charge, the Borgward must be successfully ordered to Advance. Before moving, place a 4" template in contact with the centre of the front hull of the vehicle, then execute a reverse move straight back. After this, any model hit by the template counts as hit by a heavy howitzer, except that the Pen is +5 and that units in buildings (and the buildings themselves) suffer 4D6 hits instead.

rules.name: Remote-controlled
rules.text: It is assumed the vehicle operator is just outside the gaming area, operating the vehicle by remote. After giving a successful order to the Borgward B-IV, and before it moves, roll a die. On a roll of 1 the radio transmitter has lost contact with the vehicle: instead of executing the order, it simply goes Down where it is. On a roll of 2 the tranmitter is malfunctioning: the Borgward B-IV makes a reverse move directly backwards instead of the order envisioned by the player controlling the vehicle. On any other roll (3-6) the Borgward B-IV acts normally. If a roll ever needs to be taken on another chart that affects the Borgward B-IV's movement (E.g., mud, rubble, snow, etc.), both rolls need to be taken.

Open-topped

weapons.Special: 360 degree arc, Crew-fired MMG, Hitlers Buzz Saw

rules.name: Crew-fired MMG
rules.text: The crew can either shoot the main gun, or the MMG - but not both.

rules.name: HE (4")
rules.text: PEN: +4, PIN: D3 (3D6 if in building) - Infantry and artillery can go down to halve the hits taken. 10+ hits on building collapses it and kills all inside.

rules.name: Hitlers Buzz Saw
rules.text: German light and medium machine guns fire one extra shot. Note that this applies to all light and medium machine guns, both those carried by infantry units and vehicle-mounted ones. For vehicles, halve the number of shots then add 1. (Already applied to ROF value).

rules.name: Howitzer
rules.text: Can either shoot directly at a target drawing its line of fire 'over open sights' in the normal way, or it can shoot indirect fire. When using indirect fire, a howitzer has a minimum range; when firing over open sights it has no minimum range.

rules.name: Open-topped
rules.text: Pinned by hits from small arms in the same way as soft-skins and infantry. If assaulted by infantry, open-topped armoured vehicles are destroyed automatically if the vehicle is damaged, in the same way as for soft-skins. If hit against top armour then add an additional +1 to the damage result roll. Note that all hits upon the upper surface of armoured vehicles count +1 penetration regardless of whether the target is open or not - so open-topped armoured vehicles suffer a double penalty: +1 penetration and +1 damage result

armyRules.name: Hitler's Buzz Saw
armyRules.text: German light and medium machine guns fire 1 extra shot. Note that this applies to all light and medium machine guns, both those carried by the infantry units and vehicle-mounted ones (for vehicle-mounted ones, first halve the number of shots they roll, then add +1 to the halved number).

armyRules.name: Blitzkrieg
armyRules.text: Regular and Veteran German officers may take 1 additional order dice from the bag when making a "You men, snap to action!".

armyRules.name: Initiative Training
armyRules.text: Regular and Veteran German units are not affected by the -1 morale penalty for losing the squad/team leader.

armyRules.name: Panzer Ace
armyRules.text: A single Veteran vehicle in your Force (among those that have this option in their vehicle entry) may be designated a Panzer Ace. When using its main gun it receives an additional +1 Pen modifier on the roll to damage all enemy vehicles, as well as an additional +1 modifier when rolling on the damage table. This does not apply to co-axial weapons.

profile.Weapons: 1 platform-mounted light automatic cannon with 360-degree arc of fire

options.name: Option10
options.text: Replace the light autocannon with 4 light autocannons for +90pts

options.name: Option11
options.text: Add armoured cab, changing vehicle to an oppen-topped armoured carrier (damage value 7+) for +20pts

rules.name: Flak
rules.text: All enemy with the Flak special rule automatically fire at the attacking aircraft if the token model lies within their range and firing arc, regardless of whether they have already taken an action or not that turn. Flak fire does not require an action and takes place outside of the normal turn sequence. Firing a pintle-mounted machine gun flak weapon against an attacking aircraft does not make the vehicle count as open-topped for the turn. Any flak units in Ambush retain their Ambush status if they shoot at an aircraft. Hidden lose their hidden status. Friendly units must test to hold their fire (Inexperienced 4+, Regular 3+, Veteran 2+) - in case of Rookie pilot all flak units open fire automatically. Measure range - Line of Site ignored. Flak weapons not pinned hit on 5+, pinner hit on 6 - ignore all other modifiers. If HE hits, multiply as for inside a building. If 3 or more hits, shot down.

rules.text: No modifiers apply for penetration when shooting at the sides, rear, or from above. All shots count against the full armour value.

rules.name: Flamethrower
rules.text: Hits from flamethowers allow no cover saves. When shooting with a flamethrower, roll a single die to hit as normal, but if you score a hit, it is turned into D6 hits (or D6+1 in the case of a vehicle-mounted flamethrower). As no saves are allowed, simply roll for damaage in the usual manner. Flamethrowers always hit the top armour of vehicles. Also, they don't suffer the -1 Pen penalty when firing at long range against armoured vehicles, nor the +1 Pen for firing at point-blank range. Causes D3+1 pins to target, 1 pin to firing unit. A unit hit by a flamethrower must check its morale regardless of casualties. After shooting roll a D6 (for each flamethrower fired). On a result of 1 or 2 the flamethrower has run out of fuel. Infantry: replace model with unarmed model, else remove the model instead (no morale check caused). Vehicles: no other effects. When rolling on Vehicle Damage Results table against a vehicle equipped with flamethrowers, add an extra +1 to the roll.

rules.name: Armoured all around
rules.text: No modifiers apply for penetration when shooting at the sides, rear, or from above. All shots count against the full armour value.

rules.name: Flak
rules.text: All enemy with the Flak special rule automatically fire at the attacking aircraft if the token model lies within their range and firing arc, regardless of whether they have already taken an action or not that turn. Flak fire does not require an action and takes place outside of the normal turn sequence. Firing a pintle-mounted machine gun flak weapon against an attacking aircraft does not make the vehicle count as open-topped for the turn. Any flak units in Ambush retain their Ambush status if they shoot at an aircraft. Hidden lose their hidden status. Friendly units must test to hold their fire (Inexperienced 4+, Regular 3+, Veteran 2+) - in case of Rookie pilot all flak units open fire automatically. Measure range - Line of Site ignored. Flak weapons not pinned hit on 5+, pinner hit on 6 - ignore all other modifiers. If HE hits, multiply as for inside a building. If 3 or more hits, shot down.

rules.name: HE (3")

rules.name: Hitlers Buzz Saw

rules.name: Howitzer

rules.name: Open-topped

If hit against top armour then add an additional +1 to the damage result roll. Note that all hits upon the upper surface of armoured vehicles count +1 penetration regardless of whether the target is open or not - so open-topped armoured vehicles suffer a double penalty: +1 penetration and +1 damage result

rules.name: Flak
rules.text: All enemy with the Flak special rule automatically fire at the attacking aircraft if the token model lies within their range and firing arc, regardless of whether they have already taken an action or not that turn. Flak fire does not require an action and takes place outside of the normal turn sequence. Firing a pintle-mounted machine gun flak weapon against an attacking aircraft does not make the vehicle count as open-topped for the turn. Any flak units in Ambush retain their Ambush status if they shoot at an aircraft. Hidden lose their hidden status. Friendly units must test to hold their fire (Inexperienced 4+, Regular 3+, Veteran 2+) - in case of Rookie pilot all flak units open fire automatically. Measure range - Line of Site ignored. Flak weapons not pinned hit on 5+, pinner hit on 6 - ignore all other modifiers. If HE hits, multiply as for inside a building. If 3 or more hits, shot down.

rules.name: Open-topped
rules.text: Pinned by hits from small arms in the same way as soft-skins and infantry. If assaulted by infantry, open-topped armoured vehicles are destroyed automatically if the vehicle is damaged, in the same way as for soft-skins. If hit against top armour then add an additional +1 to the damage result roll. Note that all hits upon the upper surface of armoured vehicles count +1 penetration regardless of whether the target is open or not - so open-topped armoured vehicles suffer a double penalty: +1 penetration and +1 damage result

rules.name: Flamethrower
rules.text: Hits from flamethowers allow no cover saves. When shooting with a flamethrower, roll a single die to hit as normal, but if you score a hit, it is turned into D6 hits (or D6+1 in the case of a vehicle-mounted flamethrower). As no saves are allowed, simply roll for damaage in the usual manner. Flamethrowers always hit the top armour of vehicles. Also, they don't suffer the -1 Pen penalty when firing at long range against armoured vehicles, nor the +1 Pen for firing at point-blank range. Causes D3+1 pins to target, 1 pin to firing unit. A unit hit by a flamethrower must check its morale regardless of casualties. After shooting roll a D6 (for each flamethrower fired). On a result of 1 or 2 the flamethrower has run out of fuel. Infantry: replace model with unarmed model, else remove the model instead (no morale check caused). Vehicles: no other effects. When rolling on Vehicle Damage Results table against a vehicle equipped with flamethrowers, add an extra +1 to the roll.

rules.name: Flamethrower
rules.text: Hits from flamethowers allow no cover saves. When shooting with a flamethrower, roll a single die to hit as normal, but if you score a hit, it is turned into D6 hits (or D6+1 in the case of a vehicle-mounted flamethrower). As no saves are allowed, simply roll for damaage in the usual manner. Flamethrowers always hit the top armour of vehicles. Also, they don't suffer the -1 Pen penalty when firing at long range against armoured vehicles, nor the +1 Pen for firing at point-blank range. Causes D3+1 pins to target, 1 pin to firing unit. A unit hit by a flamethrower must check its morale regardless of casualties. After shooting roll a D6 (for each flamethrower fired). On a result of 1 or 2 the flamethrower has run out of fuel. Infantry: replace model with unarmed model, else remove the model instead (no morale check caused). Vehicles: no other effects. rules.name: Flamethrower
rules.text: Hits from flamethowers allow no cover saves. When shooting with a flamethrower, roll a single die to hit as normal, but if you score a hit, it is turned into D6 hits (or D6+1 in the case of a vehicle-mounted flamethrower). As no saves are allowed, simply roll for damaage in the usual manner. Flamethrowers always hit the top armour of vehicles. Also, they don't suffer the -1 Pen penalty when firing at long range against armoured vehicles, nor the +1 Pen for firing at point-blank range. Causes D3+1 pins to target, 1 pin to firing unit. A unit hit by a flamethrower must check its morale regardless of casualties. After shooting roll a D6 (for each flamethrower fired). On a result of 1 or 2 the flamethrower has run out of fuel. Infantry: replace model with unarmed model, else remove the model instead (no morale check caused). Vehicles: no other effects. When rolling on Vehicle Damage Results table against a vehicle equipped with flamethrowers, add an extra +1 to the roll.

rules.text: This vehicle cannot be given the Command Vehicle special rule and therefore cannot be the command vehicle of an Armoured Platoon.

rules.name: Heavy Charge
rules.text: The heavy charge can only be used once per game, but it does indeed go off with a huge bang. In order to use the charge, the Borgward must be successfully ordered to Advance. Before moving, place a 4" template in contact with the centre of the front hull of the vehicle, then execute a reverse move straight back. After this, any model hit by the template counts as hit by a heavy howitzer, except that the Pen is +5 and that units in buildings (and the buildings themselves) suffer 4D6 hits instead.

rules.name: Remote-controlled
rules.text: It is assumed the vehicle operator is just outside the gaming area, operating the vehicle by remote. After giving a successful order to the Borgward B-IV, and before it moves, roll a die. On a roll of 1 the radio transmitter has lost contact with the vehicle: instead of executing the order, it simply goes Down where it is. On a roll of 2 the tranmitter is malfunctioning: the Borgward B-IV makes a reverse move directly backwards instead of the order envisioned by the player controlling the vehicle. On any other roll (3-6) the Borgward B-IV acts normally. If a roll ever needs to be taken on another chart that affects the Borgward B-IV's movement (E.g., mud, rubble, snow, etc.), both rolls need to be taken.

rules.name: Flak
rules.text: All enemy with the Flak special rule automatically fire at the attacking aircraft if the token model lies within their range and firing arc, regardless of whether they have already taken an action or not that turn. Flak fire does not require an action and takes place outside of the normal turn sequence. Firing a pintle-mounted machine gun flak weapon against an attacking aircraft does not make the vehicle count as open-topped for the turn. Any flak units in Ambush retain their Ambush status if they shoot at an aircraft. Hidden lose their hidden status. rules.text: Can either shoot directly at a target drawing its line of fire 'over open sights' in the normal way, or it can shoot indirect fire. When using indirect fire, a howitzer has a minimum range; when firing over open sights it has no minimum range.

rules.name: Open-topped
rules.text: Pinned by hits from small arms in the same way as soft-skins and infantry. If assaulted by infantry, open-topped armoured vehicles are destroyed automatically if the vehicle is damaged, in the same way as for soft-skins. If hit against top armour then add an additional +1 to the damage result roll. Note that all hits upon the upper surface of armoured vehicles count +1 penetration regardless of whether the target is open or not - so open-topped armoured vehicles suffer a double penalty: +1 penetration and +1 damage result

armyRules.name: Hitler's Buzz Saw
armyRules.text: German light and medium machine guns fire 1 extra shot. Note that this applies to all light and medium machine guns, both those carried by the infantry units and vehicle-mounted ones (for vehicle-mounted ones, first halve the number of shots they roll, then add +1 to the halved number).

armyRules.text: Regular and Veteran German officers may take 1 additional order dice from the bag when making a "You men, snap to action!".

armyRules.name: Initiative Training
armyRules.text: Regular and Veteran German units are not affected by the -1 morale penalty for losing the squad/team leader.

rules.name: Howitzer
rules.text: Can either shoot directly at a target drawing its line of fire 'over open sights' in the normal way, or it can shoot indirect fire. When using indirect fire, a howitzer has a minimum range; when firing over open sights it has no minimum range.

rules.name: Open-topped
rules.text: Pinned by hits from small arms in the same way as soft-skins and infantry. If assaulted by infantry, open-topped armoured vehicles are destroyed automatically if the vehicle is damaged, in the same way as for soft-skins. If hit against top armour then add an additional +1 to the damage result roll. Note that all hits upon the upper surface of armoured vehicles count +1 penetration regardless of whether the target is open or not - so open-topped armoured vehicles suffer a double penalty: +1 penetration and +1 damage result

rules.name: Armoured all around
rules.text: No modifiers apply for penetration when shooting at the sides, rear, or from above. All shots count against the full armour value.

rules.name: Flamethrower
rules.text: Hits from flamethowers allow no cover saves. When shooting with a flamethrower, roll a single die to hit as normal, but if you score a hit, it is turned into D6 hits (or D6+1 in the case of a vehicle-mounted flamethrower). As no saves are allowed, simply roll for damaage in the usual manner. Flamethrowers always hit the top armour of vehicles. Also, they don't suffer the -1 Pen penalty when firing at long range against armoured vehicles, nor the +1 Pen for firing at point-blank range. Causes D3+1 pins to target, 1 pin to firing unit. A unit hit by a flamethrower must check its morale regardless of casualties. After shooting roll a D6 (for each flamethrower fired). On a result of 1 or 2 the flamethrower has run out of fuel. Infantry: replace model with unarmed model, else remove the model instead (no morale check caused). Vehicles: no other effects. When rolling on Vehicle Damage Results table against a vehicle equipped with flamethrowers, add an extra +1 to the roll.

rules.name: Armoured all around
rules.text: No modifiers apply for penetration when shooting at the sides, rear, or from above. All shots count against the full armour value.

rules.name: Flak
rules.text: All enemy with the Flak special rule automatically fire at the attacking aircraft if the token model lies within their range and firing arc, regardless of whether they have already taken an action or not that turn. Flak fire does not require an action and takes place outside of the normal turn sequence. Firing a pintle-mounted machine gun flak weapon against an attacking aircraft does not make the vehicle count as open-topped for the turn. Any flak units in Ambush retain their Ambush status if they shoot at an aircraft. Hidden lose their hidden status. Friendly units must test to hold their fire (Inexperienced 4+, Regular 3+, Veteran 2+) - in case of Rookie pilot all flak units open fire automatically. Measure range - Line of Site ignored. Flak weapons not pinned hit on 5+, pinner hit on 6 - ignore all other modifiers. If HE hits, multiply as for inside a building. If 3 or more hits, shot down.

rules.name: HE (2")
rules.text: PEN: +2, PIN: D2 (D6 if in building) - Infantry and artillery can go down to halve the hits taken (rounded up).

rules.name: HE (3")
rules.text: PEN: +3, PIN: D3 (2D6 if in building) - Infantry and artillery can go down to halve the hits taken. 10+ hits on building collapses it and kills all inside.

rules.name: Hitlers Buzz Saw
rules.text: German light and medium machine guns fire one extra shot. Note that this applies to all light and medium machine guns, both those carried by infantry units and vehicle-mounted ones. For vehicles, halve the number of shots then add 1. (Already applied to ROF value).

rules.name: Howitzer
rules.text: Can either shoot directly at a target drawing its line of fire 'over open sights' in the normal way, or it can shoot indirect fire. When using indirect fire, a howitzer has a minimum range; when firing over open sights it has no minimum range.

rules.name: Open-topped
rules.text: Pinned by hits from small arms in the same way as soft-skins and infantry. If assaulted by infantry, open-topped armoured vehicles are destroyed automatically if the vehicle is damaged, in the same way as for soft-skins. If hit against top armour then add an additional +1 to the damage result roll. Note that all hits upon the upper surface of armoured vehicles count +1 penetration regardless of whether the target is open or not - so open-topped armoured vehicles suffer a double penalty: +1 penetration and +1 damage result

armyRules.name: Hitler's Buzz Saw
armyRules.text: German light and medium machine guns fire 1 extra shot. Note that this applies to all light and medium machine guns, both those carried by the infantry units and vehicle-mounted ones (for vehicle-mounted ones, first halve the number of shots they roll, then add +1 to the halved number).

armyRules.name: Blitzkrieg
armyRules.text: Regular and Veteran German officers may take 1 additional order dice from the bag when making a "You men, snap to action!".

armyRules.name: Initiative Training
armyRules.text: Regular and Veteran German units are not affected by the -1 morale penalty for losing the squad/team leader.

armyRules.name: Panzer Ace
armyRules.text: A single Veteran vehicle in your Force (among those that have this option in their vehicle entry) may be designated a Panzer Ace. When using its main gun it receives an additional +1 Pen modifier on the roll to damage all enemy vehicles, as well as an additional +1 modifier when rolling on the damage table. This does not apply to co-axial weapons.
